estimate.source: User-supplied photograph: PROCENA KAPACITETA ELEKTRICNE MREZE NOVOG SADA (2025), supplied 2026-09-10. Estimates transcribed from image; underlying utility sources not independently verified.
estimate.interpretation: Align aggregate MV delivery transformer equivalents to 20/10-kV estimates in proportion to original station MVA. Preserve electrical impedances, feeder ratings and 110/35-kV station ratings. Do not add successive voltage-layer capacities. Transmission, LV, unspecified transformer total and reserve remain reference-only: the image does not provide compatible asset-level constraints or an operating demand snapshot.

capacity_alignment.boundary: MV AC power flow with aggregate transmission and downstream capacity constraints

demand_reassignment.method: Largest feeder branches assigned first to the remaining 20-kV source with lowest projected demand/original-MVA ratio; original feeder impedances retained as planning equivalents.

operating_model.transformer_interpretation: The unspecified 150 MW is assigned to an aggregate downstream MV/LV stage for this scenario; not a verified asset inventory.
operating_model.reserve_interpretation: The last 25% of each rating is usable reserve. Show reserve use above 75%; enforce the full 100% rating.
operating_model.lv_allocation: Editable fractions of baseline and EV demand; defaults 0.5 and 1.0 are assumptions, not supplied measurements.
operating_model.electrical_boundary: Transmission and downstream LV stages are aggregate kW constraints, not additional AC assets. MV power flow accounts for each load once.

playground_assumptions: Removed NS1, NS6 and FUT supplies; reassigned their complete demand to retained 20-kV feeder equivalents. Interstation 35-kV links retained.
Equivalent subtree feeder approximation is not an exact network reduction.
